1.d4 Nf6 2.Nf3 b6 3.g3 Bb7 4.Bg2 c5 5.c4.strategy: Recaptures with the queen, which stands centrally and eyes the b6 pawn and the knight on f6. The price is that the queen can be harassed by Black's pieces, so White has to develop with care and make use of the lead in space.
